mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or rank IC between FEDFUNDS change and SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger immediate equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or rank IC between UNRATE change and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering a negative equity feedback loop that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.5 during supply chain disruption periods indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.5, or rank IC between INDPRO and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent CPI inflation above 280 signals sustained price pressures that trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 280, or rank IC between CPIAUCSL and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate above 0.1% and CPI inflation above 282 signal aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both conditions hold, or interaction term rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment below 3.8% combined with payroll growth above 150k during late-cycle expansion indicates overheating labor markets that drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.8% and PAYEMS > 150k, or interaction term rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production above 101 indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 101, or rank IC between INDPRO and SPX returns is below 0.03.
